title: Percentage of an amount
examples: How do I find ten percent of a number?
Can you show me how to use a multiplier for percentages?
Is there an easy way to find one percent of something?

explain.say: Today we learn to find a percentage of an amount. We will look at ten percent and one percent first.
To find ten percent of a number, you can simply move the decimal point one place to the left. For example, ten percent of eighty is eight.
Finding one percent is similar. You move the decimal point two places to the left. So, one percent of eighty is zero point eight.
When you need to find a bigger percentage, like thirty-five percent, you can use a calculator multiplier. You just change the percentage to a decimal and multiply.

faq.a: Percent means out of one hundred. The word percent comes from the Latin words per hundred. It is a fraction with a denominator of one hundred.

faq.q: How do I find ten percent of a number quickly?
faq.a: You can find ten percent by dividing the number by ten. This is the same as moving the decimal point one place to the left. For example, ten percent of ninety is nine.
asks: Can I just divide by ten?

faq.q: If I want to find one percent, what do I do?
faq.a: To find one percent, you move the decimal point two places to the left. Remember that moving it two places is the same as dividing by one hundred. For example, one percent of five hundred is five.

faq.q: Do I always have to use a calculator for percentages?
faq.a: No, you can use the 10% and 1% methods for smaller percentages. However, using the decimal multiplier is always a reliable way to check your answer.
asks: Is there a non-calculator way for 35%?
When should I use a calculator?

faq.q: What is the best way to calculate 35% of 80?
faq.a: The best way is to convert thirty-five percent to the decimal zero point thirty-five. Then you multiply zero point thirty-five by eighty. This gives you twenty-eight.
asks: What is the decimal form of 35%?

facts: Percent means out of one hundred.
To convert a percentage to a decimal, divide by one hundred.
Ten percent of any number is the number divided by ten.
One percent of any number is the number divided by one hundred.

quiz.say: What is ten percent of ninety?
quiz.why: Ten percent is the same as dividing by ten, so ninety divided by ten is nine.

wrong.0: This is ten percent of ninety if you move the decimal one place only.
wrong.1: This is what you get if you multiply by ten instead of dividing.
wrong.3: This is the number itself, not the percentage.

quiz.say: What is one percent of two hundred?
quiz.why: One percent means dividing by one hundred, so two hundred divided by one hundred is two.

wrong.0: This is one percent of twenty.
wrong.1: This is the original number, not the percentage.
wrong.3: This is ten percent of two hundred.

quiz.why: Convert thirty-five percent to zero point thirty-five, and then multiply zero point thirty-five by eighty.
